name: kcore-mcp
description: MCP server for kcore. Plans and applies clusters, VMs, networks, and storage the way Terraform would, and asks the operator before it changes anything.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __kcoreCreateRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __kcoreCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' && chmod +x dist/index.js
